name: Russia–NATO
value: Estonia to shut Russia border from 1 Dec
summary: Estonia will close its Russian border crossings from 1 Dec after a sabotage plot it blames on Russia; no Article 4
state: Estonia will close its border crossings with Russia from 1 Dec after an attempted arson at drone maker Threod Systems on 14 Nov, which it blames on Russian military intelligence (The Moscow Times, 16 Nov). NATO jets were scrambled during overnight drone alerts across the Baltic states on 11 Nov and failed to down one drone (Euronews). On 18 Nov Rzeczpospolita reported a planned but unexecuted Russian false-flag attack from Poland into Kaliningrad (ISW). No Article 4 request or direct clash was found as of 20 Nov.
for_you: Travellers between Estonia and Russia should expect land crossings to close from 1 Dec. Check FCDO travel advice for Estonia and Russia before travelling.
rubric_hit: Watch: sabotage attributed to Russia (Estonia, 14 Nov) and drone alerts in Baltic airspace (11 Nov); no Article 4 or clash
